# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.6.1

Version 1.6.1 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.6.0

All in the full touch mode (Settings → Gameplay → Touch controls → Full touch).

**Mailboxes, the notice board and the other things you use now answer a tap.** A tap on a mailbox, the notice
board, the map or music board, a sign, a gyroid or a villager's door walks you to the side it answers from and uses
it: the notice board and the other boards from the front (facing them), a mailbox from its front, a gyroid from the
nearest side, a door from the front. If nothing happens there, the other sides are tried. Until now the player went
to the nearest side and pressed A there, which these things do not take (the notice board did nothing, the mailbox
only sometimes opened).

**A tap on the top of a tall thing means that thing.** A tap on a tree's crown or the top of the notice board fell
on the ground behind it (the screen's ray meets the ground there), so the player walked past it. Trees, boards,
mailboxes, signs, gyroids and doors are now found as tall as they stand.

**Around things on the way.** Walking up to such a thing or to a villager, a player stopped by something (a fence,
the board's corner) steps aside and goes on. A plain walk still goes straight, as a door is entered by walking into
it.

**Events.** A snowball is pushed by walking with it, and an umbrella's twirl ends with a walk as with the stick (until
now the player stood still in both). Everything else that waits for A (climbing out of a pitfall, the scenes of
the events, the boat and the train) takes a tap anywhere, and the morning exercises follow a drag as they would the
stick.

**The furniture mode tells the furniture's name.** A tap on a piece, in the room or in the row of your pockets'
furniture at the bottom, shows its name above the row, in the game's own letters (in Korean with the Korean patch).

- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog). If GitHub answers with an error, try again a little later.
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- The multiplayer protocol is the same as v1.5.2's to v1.6.0's: they can be in the same room. 32-bit and 64-bit
  players can play together, whatever graphics API each uses.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer). For players from
  other networks, the surest way is UPnP turned on in the host's router, or UDP 47070 forwarded to the host's device.

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.6.1-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`; OpenGL 3.3, Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 (Windows 10+) |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.6.1-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`; OpenGL 3.3, Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.6.1-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 or Vulkan 1.0 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.6.1-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a); Vulkan on Android 7.0+ |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

Played by script with touches on a 1280x720 window, outside the player's house on the plaza:

- **The notice board**: a tap on its upper part walked the player around its corner to its front, facing it, and the
  board opened (v1.6.0: the player stopped at its side and nothing opened).
- **The mailbox**: a tap on it walked the player to its front and the mailbox opened with its letters.
- **The gyroid** by the house: a tap on it walked up and started its talk.
- **The house's door**: a tap on it still walked the player in.
- **The furniture mode**: a tap on a piece in the pockets' row showed its name (클래식장식장 with the Korean patch), and a
  tap on a piece placed in the room showed its name (할로윈 옷장).
- The touches of v1.6.0's checks (walking, talking, choices, picking up, digging, the pockets, the map, the title)
  behave as before.
- The 43 scripted scenarios run for every release give the same screenshots, logged positions and saves on v1.6.0
  and on this version, touch off.
- All unit tests pass; the decomp change is inside `TARGET_PC` only and the matching build's hashes are unchanged.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.6.1, versionCode 10601); the four
  files hold the same files as v1.6.0's.

## Known limitations

- Inside the mailbox, the notice board and other menus but the pockets and the map, the GameCube pad comes up as in
  v1.6.0 (they are worked with its buttons).
- The full touch mode was checked with touches given by script on the desktop, not yet on a phone.
- The limitations of v1.6.0 remain (see its [release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.6.0)).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
